blocks.p: 50 positions each, outside the shared sets. Error rates are rough (about ±10 to ±25): enough to spot a clearly weak model, not to rank models. This page feeds no ranking, chart or finding. Sorted by name. Every value is shown with its count and interval: the minimum-sample rule of the other pages does not apply here. Rows marked "also in League N" are models that also play a league; their league results are on the Leagues page and are never compared with these 50 positions.
